# Sources: site and regulatory scenarios

Checked 17 September 2026. This is a source hierarchy, not a legal opinion.

## Official publication index

https://buildnow.telangana.gov.in/go-and-act/

The Telangana building-permission service is the relevant starting point for
current government orders and acts. The page was reachable, but its dynamically
loaded order list was not exposed by the text fetch used during authoring.
Therefore this skill does not claim an exhaustive current-amendment check.
Inspect the live publication list or obtain the applicable document before
changing a rule.

## G.O.Ms.No.95, dated 21 March 2026

Original document mirror:
https://archive.org/download/in.gov.telangana.goir.2026-03-21.municipal-administration-and-urban-development-manuscript-95/municipal-administration-and-urban-development-manuscript-95.pdf

Searchable OCR:
https://archive.org/download/in.gov.telangana.goir.2026-03-21.municipal-administration-and-urban-development-manuscript-95/municipal-administration-and-urban-development-manuscript-95_djvu.txt

The inspected OCR states a 21 m high-rise definition, a 750-2,000 sq m TDR
height-band provision, and a separate additional-floor provision for plots above
2,000 sq m with specified road conditions. It also states that parking and other
requirements continue to apply.

This is an archive of a government document, not the current approval authority.
OCR can misread digits and clause labels. Verify decisive text against the PDF
and current official amendments; do not treat the OCR alone as certified law.

## Parent rules and local interpretation

The repository's `docs\regulatory-basis.md` links the parent G.O.Ms.No.168 and
other publication sources. Its current tables intentionally retain specified
2012 cells and disclose amendment limitations. Read those qualifications and the
actual `index.html` calculation branches.

`docs\plot-geometry.md` distinguishes buildable envelope, net property and
area deductions. `README-prohibited-properties.md` documents source reports,
OCR/cache behavior and the limits of interpreting property-list results.

## Evidence checklist

- Publication body, order/act number, date and exact applicable provision.
- Original text versus machine-readable/OCR interpretation.
- Applicability to jurisdiction, use, plot band, road, height and other controls.
- Current amendment/supersession status and unresolved conflicts.
- Which result is a modelled scenario rather than verified site/legal evidence.
